title: Company SPARQ Week - Runbook & Exec Prep (Draft)
content:
Purpose:
This is the working runbook for the first company-wide SPARQ Week: a condensed alignment sprint for exec updates, OKR sanity-checks, and a single all-hands rehearsal. Treat as living draft — intended to consolidate messy inputs from product, eng, GTM, and people ops into a tight, executable week.

High-level goals:
- Surface risky dependency vectors and ownerable mitigations before the quarter starts.
- Align exec messaging so the all-hands is crisp and prescriptive (what we will measure, what we will stop doing).
- Leave the week with: a) finalized top-level OKR drafts, b) 6 cross-team action items with clear owners and due dates, c) a rehearsed all-hands run of show.

Dates & cadence:
- SPARQ Week window: Mon 2025-03-10 through Fri 2025-03-14.
- Daily pattern: 0900-0930 sync (lead owners), 1000-1200 working blocks (tactical deep dives), 1400-1600 alignment sessions (cross-functional), 1600-1700 wrap & decision log.

Primary owners:
- Runbook lead: Asha Patel (company-ops)
- Exec messaging & CEO prep: Nina Park (comms)
- OKR synthesis: Priya Singh (product-ops)
- All-hands production: Lucas Mayer (events/PE)
- Infrastructure readiness & risk: Omar Malik (infra)
content_continued:
Agenda (compact):
Day 0 (preweek): final prework push, ask all leads to submit one slide + 3-line risk statement.
Day 1: State of the company (finance + product cadence). Quick wins + risk inventory.
Day 2: OKR workshopping (breakouts per objective). Prioritize measurable KRs.
Day 3: Exec sync & escalation matrix. Rehearse CEO opening + critical scripts.
Day 4: All-hands tech/dry run + recording plan. Final decision log and action assignment.

Prework (required):
- Leads: 1 slide deck (1-3 slides) with current metric baseline, ask, top risk, mitigation. File to confluence by EOD Wed 2025-03-05.
- All-hands hosts: submit AV test checklist and run of show draft by Fri 2025-03-07.
- People ops: proposed recognition segment and new hire highlight list.

Draft OKRs (top-line roughs to iterate during SPARQ Week):
Objective A: Make inference predictable and cost-efficient for production teams.
- KR A1: Reduce 99th pct tail latency for hosted text-gen by 15% (baseline: 340ms) - owner: eng-serving-runtime
- KR A2: Lower per-token cost for the 80th percentile customer by 18% via batching & cache tuning - owner: optimize-team
- KR A3: Publish quantified performance profiles for top 10 models in catalog (docs + SDK examples) - owner: developer-experience

Objective B: Grow enterprise readiness & adoption for Dedicated/Private.
- KR B1: Close 3 reserved-capacity contracts > $100k ARR each - owner: sales-enterprise
- KR B2: Complete private cloud deploy automation for two major partners (proof-of-concept) - owner: private-deployments
- KR B3: Achieve SOC-like audit readiness checklist completed for top 6 compliance items - owner: security-and-compliance

Objective C: Improve platform reliability and graceful degradation.
- KR C1: Implement and test region fallback policy for 2 top customer routes (automated failover) - owner: platform-engineering
- KR C2: Reduce critical production incident MTTR from 42m to 25m - owner: site-reliability-engineering

Exec update talking points (bullet-ready):
- Q4 fiscal recap: usage growth +15% month-over-month, hosted API revenue up, but unit economics pressure on LLM-heavy customers.
- Deployment traction: 2 new Dedicated pilots signed; Private PoC pipeline growing in regulated financial accounts.
- Core improvements shipped this quarter: continuous batching, early KV-cache persistence feature, console cost-view increment.
- Risks we are watching: model quality regression after quantization experiments; GPU supply variability for Dedicated; slower-than-expected Partner onboarding for Private.
- Asks of the org: prioritize any rollout blockers flagged in Spike tickets by Mar 3; teams with cross-cutting infra changes must enter the guardrail review process.

Production & all-hands run of show (draft):
- 10:00 CEO opening (12m): theme, northstar, call-to-action.
- 10:12 Leadership highlights (18m): 3 x 6m segments (Product, Eng, GTM) with 2 slide max each.
- 10:30 Demo & customer moment (8m): short recorded demo + 2-min customer quote.
- 10:38 Breakouts (15m): micro-AMA rooms run by product areas.
- 10:53 Recognition + close (7m).
- Post-hangouts: team AMAs in slack channels for 48 hours.

AV / Logistics checklist (quick):
- Test streaming mic and recording pipeline by Wed 2025-03-12 17:00.
- Backup: pre-render CEO opening + leadership segments and have local copies on two machines.
- Stage manager: Rae Thompson. Runbook SLACK channel: #sparq-week-prod.

Decision matrix & escalation path:
- If KR baseline data is missing: flag to Priya by EOD Day1, default to conservative estimate and add explicit data-collection action.
- If a cross-team blocker cannot be resolved by Day2: escalate to COO office with synthesized tradeoffs.
- For all public statements in the all-hands, legal must review any customer references 48h before event.

Risk register (top 6):
1) Quantization quality regression — mitigation: feature flags, per-customer rollouts, evals tied to baseline prompts.
2) Hosting cost spike — mitigation: temporary throttles, burst capacity caps for Dedicated, and an emergency cost-control playbook.
3) Partner POC delays — mitigation: field eng triage, fixed-scope POC templates, dedicated partner PM.
4) Event tech failure — mitigation: pre-rendered videos, standby stream, AM on-call.
5) Hiring pipeline gaps for infra roles — mitigation: prioritize contractors for critical sprints, update hiring scorecards.
6) Legal/compliance late review — mitigation: earlier touchpoints, checklist in prework.

Open questions / notes to resolve during SPARQ Week:
- Which single metric from Redwood Optimize should be promoted to company-level dashboard? (ops suggestion: per-token cost for 80th percentile customers vs. total spend)
- Should the Recognition segment be limited to product wins only or include individual IC highlights? (people ops to propose format)
- Do we commit to publicizing model performance profiles at GA or beta? (devexp + research to advise)

Micro-actions assigned now (first pass):
- Priya: consolidate all slide decks and produce an OKR draft doc by Mon Day1 EOD.
- Omar: run capacity check for Dedicated clusters; surface any quota constraints by Day2.
- Lucas: deliver full AV checklist and host run-of-show by Fri preweek.
- Nina: draft CEO script and 3 Q&A fallback scenarios by Day2.
- Rae: set up #sparq-week-prod and coordinate rehearsals.

Notes-to-self (Asha):
- Keep the week ritualized but lightweight. Too many meetings will kill output — enforce the 2-hour deep dive + 1 hour sync pattern.
- Emphasize decisions over perfect artifacts. Document decisions in a single confluence decision log with owners/due dates.
- Be ruthless about scope: focus on top 3 company-level OKR problems and defer anything else.

Next steps: finalize prework asks and send calendar invites by 2025-02-21. Confirm keynote recording slot with CEO office by 2025-02-24.
